coverageDispositions.reason: DNS, discovery, network paths and sockets: Existing local socket binding verified by actual HTTP requests; DNS and external routing outside this fixture.
TLS, certificates and transport identity: The supplied task and README establish loopback HTTP only; no certificates or TLS requested.
Proxies, gateways, ingress, CDN and load balancing: No proxy, gateway, CDN or load balancer occurs in the supplied fixture.
Authentication, authorization and tenant identity: PATCH requires registry write permission; tenant is registry-derived for SELECT and UPDATE. Production identity is outside scope.
API styles, HTTP versions, RPC and streams: Actual HTTP GET and PATCH status/content-type contracts; other API styles and protocol upgrades outside scope.
CRUD, upsert and bulk semantics: Optional title/note, explicit null note clearing, absence preservation, projection and version-only update supported.
Validation, parsing, serialization and errors: 2048 bytes including chunked body; strict UTF-8; allowed fields and positive safe version; JSON errors.
Domain architecture and request lifecycle: Small route addition preserves fixture lifecycle; shared registry remains unchanged.

coverageDispositions.component: Node native HTTP and synchronous SQLite
coverageDispositions.reason: Runtime, memory, concurrency, OS and containers: Bounded body buffering and finite timeout settings; actual Windows/Node runtime observed. Slow-client deadlines, scheduling precision and load not measured.
Database modeling and DDL: Existing schema retained and exercised with same id in different tenants. No schema migration required.
DML/DQL, ORM, indexes and query plans: Bound parameters and primary-key lookup; no ORM or query-plan performance claim.

Transactions, isolation, locks and consistency: Single UPDATE compares version and increments it atomically; two simultaneous HTTP requests produce 200/409. Multi-host and overload behavior outside tested scope.
Database privileges and operational administration: No network database identities, grant management or production administration requested.
Storage, replication, partitioning, sharding and hashes: Replication, partitioning, sharding and hashing are not used by the supplied small fixture. Reopen persistence is recorded in L21.
Cache, views and derived state: No cache or materialized derived state occurs in this task.
Messaging, event logs, CDC and async effects: No messages, event logs, CDC or async external effects are requested.
Durable workers, schedules and workflows: No workers, schedules or durable workflow are part of ticket PATCH.
Files, objects, search and specialized stores: No file uploads, object storage, search or specialized store is used. The SQLite persistence check is covered elsewhere.
External APIs, webhooks, tools and MCP: No external API, webhook or MCP integration is required or used.
Traffic, capacity, scaling and cost: Input buffer cap and configured request/socket limits added. Capacity, scaling, traffic generation and cost benchmarking outside scope.
Reliability, backups and recovery: Actual close/reopen preserves north update, south data and tenant isolation. Crash recovery, backups and restore drills remain outside scope.
Observability, objectives and audit: Runnable test logs and per-request evidence added; production telemetry, SLOs and audit ingestion outside task.
Infrastructure, build and deployment lifecycle: Built-in-only runnable verification and usage instructions supplied; no deployment, container or external mutation.

decisions.mechanism: Allowlisted schema; trimmed title; nullable note; SQL CASE preserves absent fields; UPDATE RETURNING keeps projection.

decisions.mechanism: One atomic conditional UPDATE ... WHERE version=? increments version and returns winner; tenant lookup distinguishes stale from absent.
decisions.limit: Observed pair of simultaneous loopback requests on one Node process and SQLite file; no distributed or load guarantee.
decisions.failure: One request wins 200; the other receives JSON409 and does not overwrite winner.

decisions.mechanism: Count bytes before parsing; limit buffer; reject oversized Content-Length; strict UTF-8 decode; schema allowlist and media type check.
decisions.limit: 2048 body bytes; request10s/header5s/inactivity15s configured; slow-client elapsed deadlines unverified and affected by Node sweep scheduling.
decisions.failure: JSON400 malformed/schema-invalid; JSON413 oversized; JSON415 non-JSON; internal DB errors produce generic500.
